events.title: First Untethered Manned Hot Air Balloon Flight
events.description: Jean-François Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d'Arlandes ascended from Paris in a Montgolfier balloon, flying roughly 9 kilometers over about 25 minutes.
events.significance: This was the first free flight by humans in history, opening the era of aviation and demonstrating that people could travel through the air.

events.title: North Carolina Ratifies the U.S. Constitution
events.description: North Carolina became the 12th state to ratify the United States Constitution, doing so after initially declining to ratify until a bill of rights was added.
events.significance: Its ratification brought the new federal government closer to full national unity and reflected the influence of the push for a Bill of Rights, which was soon adopted as the first ten amendments.

events.title: Thomas Edison Announces the Phonograph
events.description: Thomas Edison announced his invention of the phonograph, the first device capable of both recording and reproducing sound. The announcement came in late 1877, with a public demonstration soon after.
events.significance: The phonograph launched the recorded sound industry and transformed music, communication, and entertainment worldwide.

events.title: Bloody Sunday in Dublin
events.description: During the Irish War of Independence, IRA forces killed a number of British intelligence officers in the morning, and British forces then opened fire on the crowd at a Gaelic football match at Croke Park, killing 14 civilians.
events.significance: The events intensified the conflict between Irish nationalists and British authorities, hardened public opinion, and contributed to the path toward the Anglo-Irish Treaty of 1921.

events.title: Dayton Agreement Initialed
events.description: After weeks of negotiations at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio, the leaders of Bosnia, Croatia, and Serbia initialed a peace accord to end the Bosnian War.
events.significance: The agreement ended the deadliest conflict in Europe since World War II and established the framework for Bosnia and Herzegovina's post-war government.
